catalogId.description: Canonical A2UI v0.9 catalog ID: a URI identifier (never fetched), equal to the published manifest's $id. Servers advertise it in supportedCatalogIds.

catalogAliases.description: Short names for the same catalog (docs, logs, config). Never sent as an A2UI catalogId.

route.description: GET route that serves the embedded catalog, directly under the AG-UI mount so it inherits the /agui protection chain (Host, Origin with the agent.origin_allowlist strict CORS answer, body limit, bearer auth, principal kind ui) and answers 404 when AG-UI is off.

surface.description: Name of the AG-UI CUSTOM events that carry server-built A2UI v0.9 surface messages. Pinned by const because it must equal aguiA2UIEventName in mcp/server/agui_a2ui.go.

catalog.description: Name of the one-per-run CUSTOM event advertising the catalog, emitted after RUN_STARTED when agent.a2ui is on; value is {"catalogId": ..., "catalogUrl": <serve.route>}.
